chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, who said:
I asked him about semen that gets onto a garment. He said: “Wash the entire garment if its place is hidden from you, whether it was a little or a lot.”

key_terms.اغْسِلِ: wash; the command to purify the garment
key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by impurity
key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen; the impurity being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.قَلِيلًا: a small amount of the impurity
key_terms.كَثِيرًا: a large amount of the impurity
key_terms.مَكَانُهُ: its location; the specific place of the impurity on the garment

ai.seo_question: What should be done if semen gets on a garment and its exact place is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ritual purity of clothing when contaminated by semen. If the exact spot is unknown, the whole garment is to be washed, regardless of whether the amount was small or large.
